approvalBoundary: No playable features, schedule, form statistics, transmission, triggers, agency changes, or runtime contract is approved by this fixture.

conformanceScenarios.given: Human baseline with verified supernatural source
conformanceScenarios.when: condition acquired but no form unlocked
expect: Human remains effective baseline
No automatic moon trigger, form grants, or agency changes

conformanceScenarios.given: Verified baseline and authorized wolf expression
expect: Wolf form temporarily replaces effective Species/Ancestry configuration
Original baseline remains stored and historical
No full wolf monster stat block imported

conformanceScenarios.given: A temporary wolf form is active
conformanceScenarios.when: form ends under specific effect policy
expect: Temporary form ends
Current authoritative baseline is reevaluated and restored
Lycanthropic nature itself remains unless independently ended

conformanceScenarios.given: Setting specifies compulsory transformation but no loss of player agency
expect: Form transition may be compelled
Agency remains independently determined by applicable setting rule

conformanceScenarios.given: Setting authorizes voluntary changes without any compulsory triggers
expect: No implicit control roll
No mandatory full-moon requirement

conformanceScenarios.given: Wolf form exists; hybrid form not yet unlocked
conformanceScenarios.when: expression state progresses under authorized rule
expect: Hybrid form becomes eligible only if authored
No implied new class levels or full monster grants

conformanceScenarios.given: Base Origin is legitimately changed while wolf form is active
expect: Reversion uses the new authoritative baseline
Superseded Species/Ancestry grants are not resurrected by a stale saved snapshot

conformanceScenarios.given: Supernatural influence and its form-specific grants exist
expect: Remove only influence-related entitlement
Unrelated Class, Background, Upbringing and historical facts persist
Reversion when currently transformed must follow a specifically authored rule or be adjudicated

conformanceScenarios.when: custom stage, form, trigger or agency rule is selected
expect: Only the authorized effective table state changes
Global first-party definitions remain unchanged
